-module(length_zip_dynamic_sizes).
-export([run/0]).
run() ->
    L = make(32001,[]),
    [{tag,7}] = [{A,V} || A <- [tag] && <<_:(length(L)),V:3>> <= <<0:32001,7:3>>],
    [{tag,ok}] = [{A,V} || A <- [tag] && #{(length(L)) := V} <- [#{32001=>ok}]],
    done.
make(0,A) -> A;
make(N,A) -> make(N-1,[a|A]).
